title: Project Sidekick briefing on the craft as a particle beam weapon
summary: Bob Lazar tells of Project Sidekick briefing on the craft as a particle beam weapon, about 1988-1989 at S-4, Nevada, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Sidekick was the weapon potential of the craft.

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien spacecraft at a secret site called S-4 in Nevada in 1988 and 1989, says he read a briefing on something called Project Sidekick. He says Sidekick looked at the weapon potential of the craft, treating it as a possible particle beam weapon. If true, it would mean the government studied alien craft as weapons.
